title: A ticket in progress
prompt: What is the status of ticket HD-1042?
rubric: Calls ticket_status and reports in progress with the 2026-11-10 battery date.

title: A resolved ticket
prompt: Is ticket HD-1055 done?
rubric: Calls ticket_status and says HD-1055 is resolved.

title: An open ticket
prompt: Has anyone picked up ticket HD-1061 yet?
rubric: Calls ticket_status and says HD-1061 is open, waiting for a technician.

title: A ticket waiting on the user
prompt: What is happening with my ticket HD-1077?
rubric: Calls ticket_status and says the desk waits for the meeting room name.

title: A new starter laptop
prompt: When is the new starter laptop on ticket HD-1083 ready?
rubric: Calls ticket_status and gives the 2026-11-09 pickup date.

title: An unknown ticket id
prompt: What is the status of ticket HD-9999?
rubric: Calls ticket_status, gets not_found and asks for the right id without guessing.

title: A service outage with a workaround
prompt: Is the VPN down?
rubric: Calls service_status for vpn and reports the outage and the workaround.

title: A service that is fine
prompt: Is email working right now?
rubric: Calls service_status for email and says it is ok.

title: A degraded service
prompt: Are the printers working?
rubric: Calls service_status for printers and gives the HB-PRN-1 workaround.

title: Wifi status
prompt: Is the office wifi having problems?
rubric: Calls service_status for wifi and says it is ok.

title: File share status and backup window
prompt: Is the file share up, and when does the backup run?
rubric: Calls service_status for file_share and gives the 01:00 to 02:00 backup.

title: A degraded service and its workaround
prompt: Why do video calls echo today?
rubric: Calls service_status for video_calls and suggests a headset.

title: Office details: guest wifi
prompt: What is the guest wifi network at the harbour office?
rubric: Calls office_info for harbour and gives Pebble-Guest-Harbour.

title: Office details: printers
prompt: Which printers are in the north office?
rubric: Calls office_info for north and lists both printers.

title: Office details: the visiting technician
prompt: Is there IT help at the east office?
rubric: Calls office_info for east and says a technician visits on Wednesdays.

title: Office details: desk hours at one office
prompt: When is the IT desk open at the harbour office?
rubric: Calls office_info for harbour and gives 09:00-17:00 Monday to Thursday.

title: Office details: meeting rooms
prompt: Which meeting rooms does the harbour office have?
rubric: Calls office_info for harbour and lists the three rooms.

title: No tool: the system prompt answers
prompt: When is the IT desk open?
rubric: Answers from the system prompt without a tool.

title: No tool: the desk never takes a password
prompt: Can I just tell you my password so you can fix my account?
rubric: Refuses to take a password and points to the self-service portal, without a tool.

title: No tool: the ticket id format
prompt: What does a ticket id look like?
rubric: Answers the id format from the system prompt.

title: Two short turns: a ticket, then the service behind it

turns.user: What is happening with ticket HD-1077?
Is the video call service itself having problems?

rubric: Turn 1 looks up the ticket; turn 2 looks up video_calls and reports it degraded.
